research.title: Undergraduate Research
bullets: Designed an incrementally-biased Ry-based selection schedule for a hybrid GHZ-BB84 QKD architecture, achieving a 43.67% improvement in key-generation rate over a fixed 50/50 baseline.
Result published as first-author manuscript in APL Quantum (AIP Publishing).

research.title: Independent Research — Thesis Phase
bullets: Completed the thesis phase of an intensive private research program in Quantum Computing & Information, as part of a 2-member research team.
Authored a complete manuscript draft ("Accelerating Noisy Quantum Circuit Simulation via Unitary Precomputation") and a research poster summarizing the findings.

teaching.title: CSE Lab Instructor
bullets: Teaching 3 lab sections across 2 courses, approximately 120 students total.
CSE225L (Data Structures & Algorithms Lab) – 2 Sections: Hands-on instruction in core data structures in C++ (arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs).
CSE311L (Database Management System Lab) – 1 Section: Delivering instruction in MySQL/MariaDB (XAMPP, phpMyAdmin).
Authored CSE311L lab manuals featuring problem-first scenarios.
